items.title: Hexagon and GelSight Integrate Portable Dimensional and Surface Inspection
items.excerpt: Metrology and Quality News reports Hexagon expanded its GelSight integration, linking Absolute Arm geometry scans, Mobile Series 2 surface measurements and VGMETROLOGY Essential in one coordinate system. The report cites an aerospace use case where shop-floor inspection replaced a three-day external analysis cycle.

items.title: Hexcel Advances Aerospace Design Innovation with First NCAMP Qualification for Honeycomb Core Material
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Hexcel announced NCAMP qualification of HexWeb HRH-10 aerospace honeycomb, creating what it says is the first NCAMP database for honeycomb core materials. Design-ready material data can reduce repeated qualification work and speed structural design adoption, making Hexcel a strong recurring materials-source candidate.
items.query: site:hexcel.com September 2026 CAMX 2026 aerospace honeycomb rapid cure materials

items.title: Hexcel Launches New Vented Flex-Core Honeycomb Designed to Accelerate Production of Next-Generation Space Launch Vehicles
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Hexcel launched a high-density aluminum Vented Flex-Core honeycomb for highly contoured aerospace structures. The material integrates venting with high formability to simplify composite manufacturing for space-launch structures, reinforcing Hexcel's value as a recurring aerospace materials and manufacturing watch source.
items.query: site:hexcel.com September 2026 CAMX 2026 aerospace honeycomb rapid cure materials

items.title: INSTRUCT3D Launches Additive Build Intelligence for High-Value Metal AM
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Instruct3D launched an additive-manufacturing intelligence platform combining dual-wavelength sensing, physics-based prediction and learning workflows. The company targets aerospace, defence, energy and advanced manufacturing, making it a strong emerging source for scientific AI and metal-AM process qualification.
items.query: site:instruct3d.io September 2026 Additive Build Intelligence aerospace defense metal AM

items.title: Quickparts Deepens Its Space and Defense Investment to Nearly $6 Million
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Quickparts is adding 12 Stratasys NEO systems across four countries and says the investment raises large-format throughput by 40% while standardizing qualified production across sites. Its Seattle Aerospace & Defense Center of Excellence and scale-up model make it a useful recurring advanced-manufacturing source.
items.query: site:quickparts.com September 2026 aerospace defense additive manufacturing Seattle investment
